name: cnki-research
description: Search, read, download, and critically summarize CNKI literature through an institution-authenticated Chrome session.

interface.shortDescription: Search and read CNKI with Playwright.
interface.longDescription: Controls a dedicated visible Chrome instance launched in the macOS background, allows multiple Playwright tabs without foreground activation, searches CNKI via the Nanjing University of the Arts proxy, extracts literature metadata, downloads accessible papers, reads CNKI AI full text, and produces structured critical summaries.
defaultPrompt: 在知网搜索相关论文并整理结果。
阅读全文并输出结构化总结。
下载这篇知网论文的 PDF。
